reviews.text: So incredibly happy with the service and level of care for dog., he loves coming here! I was even able to check in via phone about how he was doing and the owner promptly provided a comforting update. Not to mention how easy and convenient this location is if you work in the downtown core. Accessible and affordable pricing. This doggy daycare is an absolute gem.

My 3 year old rescue Remi loves it here! Coming to Embarkadero is easily one of her favourite parts of her weekly routine. She was a touch nervous coming in having moved to a new city, but now she pulls me to daycare even on off days. Dave and the team are the best, and she's always happy and tired out from a full day of fun when I pick her up after work. Would absolutely recommend!
I met David tonight and what a lovely, gentle, experienced guy ever to take care of your best friend. I look forward to taking my difficult little girl to Barkadero on Monday.

David was very responsive and accommodating via email when I reached out to arrange some last-minute puppy sitting for my doggo.  ❤️

Our dog absolutely loves this place (as do we). The owner Dave is brilliant and most importantly the pup is always happy to be there. They celebrate his birthday and take photos with Santa every year too which is a lovely perk!

Cara has been going to puppy daycare for a week. She loves it and I love the fact she comes home happy, exercised to the full and all of that frenetic puppy energy is spent. Best investment I’ve made to give her a solid start to her life …

Pepper loves coming here, and always has a great time! The staff take excellent care of her and always remember her. The location is the highlight for us - I work nearby and it's such a great advantage to be able to drop her off there.
